data.narrative:
Cylib is a Climate & Energy sector company at Series A stage, having raised €140M+ including a €55M Series A tranche alongside €26.1M from NRW and €63.4M from BMWE. The relevant comp universe spans one public company (LNZA) and eight private peers in the climate and energy space, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier from Series A to the next funding stage. Using €140M in total capital raised as a proxy base value yields an implied valuation of €280M. This represents the primary quantitative anchor; peer-median triangulation was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow Climate & Energy peer set, despite eight sector peers existing in the broader universe.

The analysis supports a valuation range of €238M (low) to €322M (median), centered at €280M. The range reflects stage-typical step-up dynamics while acknowledging limited comparable transaction data at this stage and sector specificity. Key uncertainties include: (1) the durability of grant funding relative to commercial revenue trajectory; (2) the heterogeneity of business models across climate-tech peers, limiting direct comparability; and (3) the absence of recent arm's-length transactions in the narrow peer cohort. A more refined range would require either materialization of peer funding events or clarity on Cylib's revenue/unit economics relative to comparable stages.
